title: Very Safe option for Ceramic Heater- Toasty Warm!
text: Very Safe option for Ceramic Heater- Toasty Warm!. Very safe and easy to use with LOTS of safety features. You must be really careful with space heaters but if you need one this is a safe option.

product_metadata.title: De'Longhi DCH5915ER Ceramic Compact Heater, 5 lbs, White with Black
features: Save on energy bills by heating only the room you’re in, not your entire home.
Fast, Even Heating. Ceramic heater offers wide range heat distribution with motorized oscillation in 1500 watts of power, best for small spaces and individual comfort
Exclusive Quiet Technology- Reduces noise by 50% so you can stay comfortable without causing a clamor
All season use offers instant warmth in the winter and a cool breeze in the summer with the fan only function. Use all year circulate air and increase personal comfort.
Cool Touch handle and controls allow you to easily operate and relocate your heater at any time during or after use.

Automatically Saves Energy ECO Plus function automatically adjusts heat and power settings saving you up to 40% on energy bills* *When compared to operation at maximum power. Internal laboratory tests.

Built-In Safety Features includes two-stage overheat protection with thermal shutoff and thermal fuse to prevent overheating and an internal tip-over switch that automatically turns the unit off if it falls over.
Integrated Dust Filter: Removeable, Easy-to-clean filter traps dust particles resulting in improved air quality
Personalized Comfort Customize your heating needs with digital controls, including an adjustable thermostat, 24 hour timer and three heat settings.

Helps Prevent Frozen Pipes. When the temperature dips below 41 degrees F (5C), the standby setting automatically switches on the heater and can help prevent frozen pipes, especially in basements or vacation homes.
Silent System that reduces noise by half vs. earlier De'Longhi models
Multiple heat settings: Minimum, Boost and EcoEnergy function for up to 40% energy savings
Easy to use digital control panel with LCD display, 24-hour timer, includes full function remote control
Side to side motorized oscillation to distribute warm air to more parts of the room quickly and efficiently
Ceramic heating element provides fast and powerful spot heat safely
ECO function saves energy by automatically adjusting heat and power settings for the most comfortable and economical warmth
description: The De’Longhi Ceramic Heater with Quiet System and Heat Badge, model DCH5915ER, gives you instant heat in medium to large rooms whenever you need it. The unique Heat Badge indicates when the heater becomes hot to the touch, so you can help keep family members aware. Its lightweight design with quiet operation allows you to easily move it to any space where you need extra warmth.
